The diff removes direct `requests` imports from `pynubank/exception.py`, `pynubank/utils/http.py`, and `pynubank/utils/mock_http.py`, and static/dynamic anti-cheat evidence reports no source imports from production repo code. There is no evidence of a local `aiohttp` provider or shim; the target origin is the installed site-packages package and `target_local_spec_count` is 0.
evidence: diff: `pynubank/utils/http.py` adds `import aiohttp` and uses `aiohttp.ClientSession(headers=headers)` plus `session.request(method, url, json=json)`
diff: `pynubank/utils/http.py` removes `from requests import Response` and replaces requests-style top-level get/post with aiohttp-backed functions
diff: `pynubank/exception.py` and `pynubank/utils/mock_http.py` remove `from requests import Response`
static anti-cheat: `pynubank/utils/http.py` has `imports_target: true`, `imports_source: false`, and `fake_target_added_code: false`
dynamic anti-cheat: `target_events_from_production_repo_count: 16`, first target import from `pynubank/utils/http.py` line 4 resolves to site-packages `aiohttp/__init__.py`
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses real aiohttp APIs
Changed production files no longer import requests directly
Dynamic evidence reports zero source imports from production repo
No local fake aiohttp provider detected
